purpose: Transcription record for Saturn-transit definitions (Sade Sati, Ardhashtama, Ashtama, Kantaka). Every entry was read from a rendered page image on 2026-09-30, not from OCR. test-saturn-transit.js asserts src/report/saturnTransitTables.js agrees with this file.
houseCounting: From the natal Moon's sign; 1 = the Moon's own sign, 2 = the next sign.

kantaka.note: The sources disagree; each reading is recorded separately.

PARASHARAS_LIGHT.page: PL 6.1 manual printed p.191, glossary: 'Transit of Saturn in the 4th and 7th rashis from the Moon.'

VISHNU_BHASKAR.page: printed p.142, IX: 'When Saturn is in 4, 7, 10th house from Moon Lagna'

PULIPPANI.page: printed pp.168-169: 4th 'Ardhashtama Sani or Kantaka Sani'; 7th 'also known as Kantaka Shani, worse than his 4th'; 8th 'Ashtama Kantaka Sani'. Introduction p.69 names only the 8th.

RATH.page: Vedic Remedies in Astrology printed p.170, footnote 52: '1st, 8th or 10th house from the Lagna, AL or Natal Moon'

kantaka.defaultReason: Houses 4 and 7 are named by three of the four sources (Parashara's Light, Vishnu Bhaskar, Pulippani); 10 by two, 8 by two, 1 by one.

1st 5 yrs. – First 2½ yrs are specially bad

notImplemented.page: Nakshatra based predictions part 1, section 34, PDF page 39: Sade-Sathi from 330.01° to 60.00° of the birth Moon's degree, Ashtama 210°-240°, Kantaka 90.01°-120.00°; the author says he 'slightly disagrees' with the usual sign-based reading.

remedies.practice: Recite an extract of Shri Rudram eleven times each morning, after bathing, facing east.
Recite a Shani verse 11 times daily during the evil transit.
Recite a Rudram extract 11 times daily for 40 days, do puja of Rudra, homa on the 41st day.

saturnGoodHouses.verseWords: ஆன்றபன் னொன்றுமூன் றீரைந் தாறு / அருக்கன்மதி ஒன்றுமூன் றாறேழ் பத்தோ / டேன்றபதி னொன்றரவு சனிசேய் மூன்றே / இருமூன்றே பத்தொன்றுமா
saturnGoodHouses.reading: Rahu, Saturn and Mars: மூன்றே (3), இருமூன்றே (2x3 = 6), பத்தொன்று (ten-and-one = 11).
saturnGoodHouses.commentaryWords: மூன்றாம், ஆறாம், பத்தாம், பதினோராம் இடங்களில் இராகுவும், சனியும் செவ்வாயும் நல்லர்
saturnGoodHouses.disagreement: The printed commentary lists four houses; the verse gives three (பத்தொன்று = 11), as do the three-entry vedha list and both English books. The verse is followed.
